scope: Released Qwen3.6-35B-A3B API build, release f1 (installed 2026-10-14). Assembled from existing reports only; no new runs.

conventions.percentiles: percentiles: linear interpolation between closest ranks (numpy "linear"); n = sample count
conventions.units: GiB = 2^30 B, MiB = 2^20 B, GB = 1e9 B; s = seconds; tok/s = tokens per second
conventions.clients: client = load generator (bench.py/soak.py, SSE timing on the client); server = ingress request_metrics.py (same host, before HTTP client); engine = FreeToken engine telemetry (GPU events per batch)
conventions.NOT_MEASURED: value not present in any existing report; nothing estimated unless labelled DERIVED

gate_verdicts.definition: final gates run f1: step -> status (STOP rows are earlier attempts superseded by re-runs, see final-gates-f1.steps)

profiles.definition: run configuration as recorded by the context-gate preflights (context, memory_ratio, gpu_expert_slots_r1b)

build.value: layer-major prefill + bit-exact CUDA NVFP4 prefill (chunk 2048) + CUDA GDN (ABI 2, cluster decode) + FP8 GEMV + attention batching k=2 + tuned decode gather + FP32 GDN snapshot + retained chunk snapshot + fused attention gate; FREETOKEN_DISABLE_JIT=1; KV BF16
build.definition: QWEN36_* switches of the served main-release configuration

identity.definition: candidate identity bound to the matrix manifest (soak analysis) and install receipts (F1/F2)

soak.workload: soak128-original-workload: sequential single client, fresh prompts 64/4K/16K/64K/120K (max_tokens 256, T=0.6, ignore_eos off, all hit length), prefix every 5, arithmetic every 7, tool every 17, cancel every 19; 5 s pause

n_requests.definition: scenario rows of this case joined to ingress + engine telemetry

ttft_client_s.definition: client: request start -> first non-empty SSE content delta (rows[].requests[].ttft_content_s)

ttft_server_s.definition: ingress: request start -> first engine token acknowledgement (telemetry.requests.ttft_generated_s)

decode_client_tps.definition: client: (completion_tokens-1)/(last content delta - first content delta)

decode_server_tps.definition: ingress: (acknowledged tokens after the first)/(last ack - first ack) (telemetry.requests.decode_ack_tps)

itl_mean_client_ms.definition: DERIVED per request: 1000/decode_client_tps = mean inter-token latency of that request; per-token ITL distribution NOT_MEASURED

prefill_tps_client.definition: DERIVED: (prompt_tokens - cached_prompt_tokens)/ttft_client_s (includes HTTP, tokenization, first decode step)

prefill_tps_engine.definition: DERIVED: engine prefill_forward_tokens/(prefill_gpu_ms/1000) (GPU-event time of prefill batches)

e2e_s_256_tokens_client.definition: client: request start -> stream end for 256 output tokens (elapsed_s)

prefill_gpu_ms.definition: engine telemetry: sum of GPU-event durations of prefill batches for the request

decode_step_gpu_ms.definition: DERIVED: decode_gpu_ms/decode_forwards (GPU-event time per decode forward, batch 1)

engine_span_s.definition: engine telemetry: first batch start -> request completion (monotonic)

scheduler_gap_ms.definition: DERIVED: engine_span - prefill_gpu - decode_gpu = engine time not covered by GPU-event-timed forwards (CPU scheduling, launch, host sync, sampling, output processing)

non_engine_ms.definition: DERIVED: ingress duration - engine span = tokenization, admission/queue wait before the first batch, stream tail (single client, no contention)

ttft_server_minus_prefill_gpu_ms.definition: DERIVED: ttft_server - prefill_gpu_ms = pre-prefill overhead (queue/tokenize/schedule) + non-GPU time inside prefill

client_minus_server_ttft_ms.definition: DERIVED: client TTFT - ingress TTFT = HTTP/SSE delivery + detokenization of the first delta

gpu_energy_per_request_J.definition: telemetry.requests.counter_deltas.gpu_energy_mj/1000 (NVML energy counter delta over the request)

gpu_mean_power_W.definition: DERIVED: gpu energy delta / ingress duration

prefix_4096_followup.note: prefix case: fresh 4K conversation + real answer + follow-up (prefix-cache hit expected); max_tokens 128

arithmetic_nonstream_32tok.definition: client wall time of the non-streaming arithmetic request (max_tokens 32, T=0)

tool_cycle_two_requests.definition: client: tool_call request + tool_final request wall times summed

matrix.design: 5 rotating pairs, same session, bf128 (original FreeToken + FP32 fix, Triton) vs main-release; output 128 tokens, T=0.6, ignore_eos; harness v6 warm-up; one request per case per arm per repeat

definitions.release_median/bf128_median: median over the 5 repeats of: client ttft_content_s, client elapsed_s (128 output tokens), client decode tps, engine prefill_gpu_ms, engine decode_gpu_ms/decode_forwards; expert counters are logical weight payload, not PCIe packet bytes
definitions.prefill_h2d_GB: expert_counter_deltas.prefill_h2d_bytes per request (logical expert-weight payload streamed host->GPU during prefill)
definitions.decode_h2d_logical_GBps: DERIVED: decode_h2d_payload_bytes / decode_gpu_ms (average over decode GPU time, not the copy-engine peak)
definitions.paired_geomean_ratio: compare-ab: geometric mean of the 5 per-pair ratios with Student-t (df=4) one-sided 97.5% bounds; only elapsed is gating

verdict.definition: compare-ab verdict; output differences are observations only (quality gated by teacher forcing)

context_gates.note: single runs per profile (not acceptance for speed); T=0 functional/boundary fixtures

decode_expert_miss_rate.definition: engine expert_decode_stats.miss_rate (decode expert lookups not resident in the GPU slot cache)
engine expert_decode_stats.miss_rate (decode expert lookups not resident in the GPU slot cache)

decode_client_tps.definition: client decode tps at the context limit (single run)

cancel_recovery_s.definition: cancel during a 120000-token prefill -> first correct follow-up answer (followup statuses [429, 429, 429, 429, 200])

warnings: min GPU free 0.789 GiB is below the ~1.0 GiB target (floor 0.5 GiB holds)

engine expert_decode_stats.miss_rate (decode expert lookups not resident in the GPU slot cache)

decode_client_tps.definition: client decode tps at the context limit (single run)

cancel_recovery_s.definition: cancel during a 60000-token prefill -> first correct follow-up answer (followup statuses [429, 429, 200])

pre_release_screens.definition: screen-chunk.py summaries, output 512 tokens, 1 request per length per round, rotating arms, NOT acceptance. main-candidate-r3 = release kernel set (release adds FREETOKEN_DISABLE_JIT=1); r2-attn = r3 without tuned gather

e2e_derived_estimate.definition: DERIVED (not measured): soak ttft_client p50 + (N-1)/decode_client_tps p50; assumes decode rate measured over 256 tokens holds for N tokens (KV growth ignored)

service_anon_GiB.definition: cgroup memory.stat anon of the inference unit; service state rows (~10 s period, 720 rows with populated engine state); early = 600..2400 s after soak start, late = last 1800 s; values in the stated unit

service_cgroup_total_GiB.definition: cgroup memory.current (anon+file+kernel); service state rows (~10 s period, 720 rows with populated engine state); early = 600..2400 s after soak start, late = last 1800 s; values in the stated unit

service_shmem_GiB.definition: cgroup shmem; service state rows (~10 s period, 720 rows with populated engine state); early = 600..2400 s after soak start, late = last 1800 s; values in the stated unit

service_file_GiB.definition: cgroup file pages; service state rows (~10 s period, 720 rows with populated engine state); early = 600..2400 s after soak start, late = last 1800 s; values in the stated unit

service_file_cache_estimate_GiB.definition: file - shmem - mapped estimate of reclaimable page cache; service state rows (~10 s period, 720 rows with populated engine state); early = 600..2400 s after soak start, late = last 1800 s; values in the stated unit

service_kernel_GiB.definition: cgroup kernel memory; service state rows (~10 s period, 720 rows with populated engine state); early = 600..2400 s after soak start, late = last 1800 s; values in the stated unit

service_memory_peak_GiB.definition: cgroup memory.peak of the unit lifetime (includes model load; reclaimable file cache)

wsl_mem_available_GiB.definition: WSL VM /proc/meminfo MemAvailable; service state rows (~10 s period, 720 rows with populated engine state); early = 600..2400 s after soak start, late = last 1800 s; values in the stated unit

wsl_swap_free_GiB.definition: WSL SwapFree (unit has MemorySwapMax=0); service state rows (~10 s period, 720 rows with populated engine state); early = 600..2400 s after soak start, late = last 1800 s; values in the stated unit

pinned_expert_bank.definition: engine host_expert_bytes == host_pinned_expert_bytes: all 40 layers x 256 experts x 1,781,760 B NVFP4 expert weights in pinned host RAM (part of service anon)

soak_analysis_leak_view.definition: per prompt length: median of request/engine values for fresh requests 3..7 vs last 5; idle state samples 600..1800 s vs last 1200 s

tunables.value: GLIBC_TUNABLES arena_max=2, mmap_threshold=1 MiB, trim_threshold=4 MiB: PASS pre and post soak, and in the installed qwen36-inference unit

startup_cgroup_peak_GiB.definition: cgroup memory peak through loaded-model readiness (before benchmark warm-up), per matrix arm start; includes reclaimable page cache from loading the checkpoint

context_gate_host.definition: evaluator host-memory checks (anon+shmem peak vs MemoryHigh 32 GiB; cgroup and file-cache peaks report-only, include model load)

gpu_free_MiB_soak.definition: NVML free (includes foreign Windows/desktop use): state rows (~10 s) and per-request minima of the 1 Hz request sampler; owner floor 0.5 GiB, target ~1 GiB; state dip 436 MiB at 14:15:59Z attributed to desktop/browser load in STATE.md; request-level dips 366-496 MiB (14:16, 14:31, 14:52Z, 64K/120K requests) are not attributed in any report; no stall or error

gpu_total_used_GiB_soak.definition: NVML used (all processes incl. desktop); service state rows (~10 s period, 720 rows with populated engine state); early = 600..2400 s after soak start, late = last 1800 s; values in the stated unit

components_GiB.definition: engine component inventory (main128): model.state_dict CUDA storages, KV pool, GDN/mamba pool, expert slot cache, allocator remainder

nvml_used_minus_torch_reserved_GiB.definition: DERIVED per request: peak NVML used - torch request peak reserved = foreign/desktop + CUDA context/driver + non-torch allocations (not separable here)

foreign_gpu_used_pre_start_GiB.definition: nvidia-smi used with no model loaded (desktop/browser/driver), before each start

min_gpu_free_MiB_by_gate.definition: minimum NVML free during requests (service sampler); context gates min_free_GiB*1024

expert_slots.definition: --moe-cache-auto resolved moe_cache_size; resident_fraction = slots / (40 layers x 256 experts)

cuda_graph_memory.definition: no release-build log line separates CUDA-graph capture memory; historical pre-release attribution in historical_attribution.vram

startup_journal_free_memory.definition: engine journal lines: free VRAM before model load and after initialization (KV + experts + graphs), KV allocation; load_to_init_s = timestamp difference of the two lines (1 s resolution)

total_pages.definition: KV pool size; state rows report kv_total_pages=131111 for main128 (1 token per page)

kv_bytes_per_token.definition: engine kv_bytes 2685173760 / 131112 allocated pages (131111 usable + 1 reserved) = 20 KiB = 10 full-attention layers x 2 KV heads x 256 dim x (K+V) x 2 B; long256 5369364480 B / 262176 = 20480 (journal "2.50 GiB / 131111 tokens" is the rounded form)

used_pages_over_soak.definition: state.kv_used_pages (pages held by running requests; 0 between requests; ~10 s sampling)

used_pages_by_active_request.definition: DERIVED: state samples taken while exactly one request was in flight, joined by ingress start/duration; most in-flight samples read 0 (e.g. during a long prefill), so only the nonzero samples show held pages (~prompt + generated tokens); short requests are rarely sampled

prefix_cache_soak.definition: prefix rows: usage cached_tokens / prompt_tokens; all_200_requests share = sum cached / sum prompt over every completed soak request (fresh prompts are unique, so mostly 0)

prefix_cache_matrix.definition: median over 5 repeats; release uses retained chunk snapshots so edits of the last message/tool result hit 16320/16448 cached tokens

mamba_gdn_slots.definition: state.mamba_used_slots / mamba_total_slots (GDN recurrent-state + snapshot slots); per-slot size DERIVED as gdn_bytes/8 assuming equal slots

decode_kv_read_bandwidth_estimate.source: $N/reports/final-f1-m-{0..4}-{bf128,main-release}.json; 700 GB/s from $W/outputs/qwen36-api/optimization/STATE.md (FlashInfer decode DRAM-bound 702-729 GB/s, cuda-attention agent)
decode_kv_read_bandwidth_estimate.definition: DERIVED: every decode step reads the whole BF16 KV of the 10 full-attention layers once: context_tokens x 20480 B; x release decode tok/s (matrix median) = average KV read rate; time at ~700 GB/s achieved DRAM rate vs the measured decode step (GDN/MoE/expert-miss time excluded)

soak_by_length.definition: summary of latency.soak.by_length.*.engine (definitions there); 256 output tokens, batch 1

queue_wait.definition: single sequential client, so admission wait is ~0; non_engine_ms (ingress duration - engine span) is the closest proxy and grows with prompt length (tokenization)

matrix_release.definition: release medians (5 repeats, 128 output tokens): expert_counter_deltas (logical expert-weight payload, not PCIe packet bytes); miss = decode expert lookup not resident in the 3164-slot GPU cache; decode_h2d_avg_GBps = decode_h2d_payload_bytes/decode_gpu_ms

long_contexts.definition: long fresh case per profile (single run): main128 120K 1 window, long256 250K 2 windows (2 x 18.245 GB), baseline64 is the unchanged chunk-major fallback (bank re-streamed per chunk); long256 has 1481 slots so decode misses ~0.38

short_prompt_ttft_floor.definition: DERIVED: every fresh or prefix-hit prefill (even 64 tokens / 186 uncached tokens) streams the full 18.245 GB expert bank once (matrix prefill_h2d_GB), so prefill GPU time >= ~0.58 s; implied rate = bank bytes / soak 64-token prefill_gpu p50 (a lower bound of the actual copy rate, since prefill time also contains compute)

prefill_tps_by_length_main128.definition: soak medians; see latency.soak.by_length for definitions

prefill_tps_long_contexts.definition: DERIVED: prompt_tokens / client TTFT, single runs

soak_requests.definition: sequential single-client soak with 5 s pauses (not a saturation test): completed_requests from the last state row; 429 = deliberate follow-up probes while a cancelled stream drains

soak_engine_busy_fraction.definition: DERIVED: sum(engine_span_s) / soak elapsed; sum(prefill_gpu_ms+decode_gpu_ms) / soak elapsed

concurrency_throughput.definition: no multi-client/saturation run exists for the release (all gates are batch-1 sequential)

cancel_recovery.definition: soak: client disconnect after first content delta of an 8192-token stream -> first correct follow-up (recovery_s from cancel start; after_disconnect from the disconnect); context gates: cancel during a long prefill -> correct follow-up

live_install_readiness.definition: final-install.sh readiness(): seconds from the first readiness.py --edge poll (issued right after the qwen36 start/restart command returned) until edge-ready (tunnel + https + profile + instance verified), 10 s poll period, 600 s cap; the two 603 s rc=1 rows were WSL->Windows interop failures, not startup time

cold_start_main128_to_edge_ready_s.definition: first main128 start after a full stop; readiness wait as above

restart_main128_s.definition: qwen36 restart -> edge-ready on a new instance

experiment_load_ready_s.definition: experiment unit start -> loaded-model readiness (harness, local, no edge/tunnel)

network_acceptance.definition: network-acceptance.py run 3 (runs 1-2 aborted by WSL interop); auto-tool-cycle FAIL = FP32-basis near-tie (direct answer "42" instead of fixture_add on a cold cache), identical on the bf128 reference; latencies are 30-prompt/3-token requests

value.reference: teacher-bf128 run 345788b2 (original FreeToken + FP32 fix), 20 cases / 943 forced tokens

teacher_forcing.definition: per-token NLL lists compared for exact float equality with the reference run; logit checkpoints every 8 positions (max_abs of logit difference). The long-120000 deviation is prefix-cache header-KV dedup (cache-state dependent, reproduced at 128K by confirm-D, absent with a clean cache in confirm-C); accepted as PASS_EQUIV_R1B256

perplexity.definition: paired cluster bootstrap over 20 fixed cases, 20000 resamples, equal token weights; relative PPL growth vs teacher-bf128

functional.definition: T=0 functional fixtures; executable-code and long-facts-16384 are FP32-basis first-token near-ties (margins 0.48/0.09 logit) with output hashes identical to the reference; baseline64 long-facts-60000 identical-sha known limitation

backend_api_checks.definition: 13 backend checks (forced tool choice 400s, penalty, seed, conflict, NaN, media, deep JSON, strict context, nonstream, seed repeat)

soak_correctness.definition: soak rows with all facts true (arithmetic expected "56", tool cycle expected "42", cancel follow-up expected "7")

matrix_output_vs_bf128.definition: sampled T=0.6 outputs; observation only (prefix-hit cases and snapshot flags differ); quality gated by teacher forcing

network_tool_cycle.value: auto-tool-cycle FAIL on cold cache (answers "42" directly); warm-cache retry calls fixture_add; identical on bf128 reference

historical_attribution.note: Numbers quoted from STATE.md agent reports on pre-release builds; context only, NOT re-measured on release f1.

copy_engine_GBps.definition: pcie-transfer microbench: single copy engine (asyncEngineCount=1 under WSL); THP banks 48.4-49.4

chunk_major_prefill_h2d_per_chunk_GB.definition: pre-layer-major: full layer bank copied per chunk per layer

layer_major_prefill_h2d_per_prompt_GB.definition: layer-major: bank streamed once per window (release matrix confirms 18.245 GB at <=120K, 2 windows = 36.5 GB at 250K)

decode_miss_cost_us.definition: pre-tuned-gather regression over engine.jsonl (~21 GB/s effective)

gpu_dram_peak_GBps.definition: RTX 5070 Ti DRAM reference used by the decode analysis

gather_fix_cost_MiB.definition: .shared::cta fix removed the 1373 MiB context stack-limit growth

wddm_desktop_slowdown.value: +0.19-0.42 ms every ~2.3 ms, 10-12% of decode-graph GPU time
wddm_desktop_slowdown.definition: environment finding: WDDM time-slicing with the 4K@159Hz desktop (hypothesis)

noise.value: CV 0.4-1.7% quiet, 3-6% under agent CPU load, up to 30% between sessions
